title: Price Increased and Review Nagging
body: I have had this app for years. They recently changed the screen layout for iPadOS and raised the price. Now, they keep nagging me for a review. Here’s your review. Now leave me alone.

title: used to be OK
body: I used to enjoy this app but it now requires a paid subscription to use. there are much better options out there.

title: Abandoned
body: Widgets stopped working. App has trouble loading even basic forecasts. Developer responded only after months of app not working. Don’t trust it. After no response for months, suddenly “new features are coming”? I think someone’s automatic, unattended cash cow ran out. I’ve moved on to HeyWeather.

title: Do not download! You’ll get charged even for the trial.
body: I downloaded the app for a seven day trial. A little too busy for me. I canceled the subscription just about an hour after I downloaded it for the trial. Still got charged for a one year subscription. Called Apple and still waiting to see what happens. Absolutely ridiculous.

title: Paid for widgets now they don’t work
body: Cancelled my renewal next month because widgets stopped working. App shows my subscription level but widgets still won’t work. Stopped about 30-60 days ago and update doesn’t fix. Find another app.

title: This was a good app...
body: Subscription expired, tried to renew and bronze option is gone. Support never responds. Horrible customer service. Other options out there guys - respond To your subscribers before they’re all gone.

title: Abandoned?
body: Like other recent posts I am concerned that the app has been abandoned. I wrote a glowing review about six months ago. The app for the phone and watch app has suddenly fallen apart. It probably has to do with a recent operating system update. Uninstalling and reinstalling has only made the problems worse. An email to support has not been answered. Very disappointed to see this with what had been one of the best weather apps available.

title: Was once great… no longer
body: App doesn’t get updated very often. Weather data often missing. It was once my favorite but not anymore.

title: Still Disappointed
body: I have discovered that if you refresh the app each and every time you open it - you get relatively accurate data. But clearly you should not have to refresh every time you use the app. None of the other weather apps I’ve tried require it. Just to clarify, i do have the app set to update in the background - it just doesn’t do it. As previously stated, the graphics are great. If the developer would fix the lack of background updating and sync the temp displays between the watch app and the phone, it would be well worth the price. As is, not so much.

title: No customer service
body: I have had this app for a couple of years and when it works it is good. But I recently have had an issue on my phone trying to reauthorize it after it accidentally got signed off. Four emails to service and no response. Tried other ways to reach them. No response. So I have paid for an app I cannot use.

title: Another bait-and-switch
body: Shows as a free app with paid options but really you have to pay to use it at all

title: Misleading
body: Is a 100% pay to use app only. The only way to use this app is to pay for their subscription service.

title: End problems
body: Bought this to use on my watch. It doesn’t update as it should. Have tried everything. Neither the watch app, watch complications, nor phone app reliably give me accurate forecasts. Bought the app, but I’m back to using the Apple weather app. Fewer features, but at least it’s accurate. Too bad, because this app LOOKS stunning.

title: No free version?
body: Are you serious? It’s weather. If you want to charge, fine, but basic should be free. Whoever rated this so high must be deranged.

title: Stopped working on Apple Watch
body: This was a good app until it became useless. No longer displays data on my watch. Problem started a few weeks ago. Tried all suggested tricks to resolve the problem but the fixes inly lasted a few hours at best. Today it doesn't work at all. I have the silver subscription. Useless. App on my iPhone is fine. Developer suggested downloading most recent version. That worked for less than two days. Although there seems to be longer periods of working until it shows no data.

title: Garbage
body: Bad service and app doesn't work as says hard to use don’t waist your time worse customer service ever save yourself 14 dollars

title: Plz release a legacy version
body: Newest/current version is very awkward, cluttered, with new features both broken and/or inaccurate and/or complete fail. Too numerous to list here. This new version 10.0.1 is unusable in so many ways. More than happy to cancel subscription and just use Apple weather, which has massively improved with recent iOS updates. It would be great if developer could release a legacy version and goes back to the previous iteration.

title: Update ruined a great app
body: For the life of me I don’t understand why developers just decide to roll out a complete app makeover in an update when everything was perfect the way it was, which is likely why you have so many subscribers. This app was clean and simple but now it looks cluttered and does not function smoothly. Your options to customize the background are limited now which looks terrible. I keep changing settings but they keep resetting to default and the annoying purple pop up tips banner has to go. And every time I open the app I get the spinning wheel for way too long. Why can’t you just leave well enough alone instead of rolling out useless updates and losing subscribers starting with me.

title: Another greedy subscription
body: These subscription-based apps are out of control. This will likely remain a pretty static app as far as features are concerned for years to come. Why should I keep paying for it over and over? What a joke. Good riddance.

title: Subscription Fatigue
body: Once the free trial concludes there is zero access to the app. Developer’s description states that a subscription is required for “full” access to the app when in fact a subscription is required for any access to the app.

title: Can’t use app AT ALL w/o Premium
body: Former Premium subscriber — had to cut costs for a little while. Still, I kept the app on my phone, and would now like to revisit/reevaluate it to determine whether or not it’s worth resubscribing to. Problem is: the app won’t let me see ANYTHING without a premium subscription. An ad-supported interface for “free” users would be one thing, but not being able to access the app at all without paying? Forecast Bar’s really working against itself by wasting a huge opportunity to show users what the app has to offer.🚮

title: Wow so bad
body: This app didn’t even work, nay LOAD, a screen half the time. Kept bugging me to set super specific, redundant and non straightforward settings. Didn’t even seem to have an special features. Didn’t have much time to check it out because after like three days it asked me to pay $6-9 monthly for this app. A WEATHER APP. please honey you ain’t all that.

title: No support - Won’t find my paid subscription
body: The link to support is broken Worked great till the renewal Now keeps asking for subscription Paid according to iTunes Restarted iPad and iPhone Removed and reinstalled the app on iPad and iPhone Seems to be a broader problem with renewals Too bad to, was a great app

title: Like the app but apparently you need a subscription
body: If you want to pay for a subscription works well, if not look elsewhere. I got this app on my desktop and paid for a subscription and it works great. It was disappointing to learn your subscription is not across devices. And now it won't even let me use the free version of the app so time to look for a better one.

title: Does not work as advertised
body: Trialed it on my Mac and it worked good so paid for the subscription mostly based on it being able to work across my devices. I have not been able to get it to work on my iPad it keeps telling me my free trial has ended when my paid subscription clearly shows in the App Store. The subscription does not work on my iPhone either but the app functions but with ads. Have not tried to put it on my TV or watch due to it not working on my other devices.

title: Paid for a for a year regular sub for widgets... now pay more?!
body: Paid for a year subscription on IOS 13, specific ally for the widget. iOS 14, ‘upgrade your subscription to use widgets’ IM SORRY POLITELY GO BAIT AND SWITCH SOMEONE ELSE. ABSOLUTELY GARBAGE.

title: Useless for 12.4.8 ios for home screen temperature
body: Disappointed I couldn't find that temperature would not show on home screen until after I paid for subscription. The app says it works on ios 12. Per the app directions I needed to pay for the Silver subscription for this function. Afterwards the settings show the function is only available for ios 13.

title: Canceled Subscription Due To Update
body: Sorry, Forecast Bar. I understand the need to pay for accurate up-to-date information. What I don’t understand is now having to pay $7.99 a year to get back widget functionality that I used to get for $2.99. That’s a pretty steep price hike, so now you get nothing a year from me. Sorry!

title: Misleading upgrades
body: It was not clear that the bronze level did not support Home Screen icons. The app is good but I only paid for upgrade for the Home Screen widgets yet not supported for bronze. Bait and switch.

title: No stars?!

Update: that has nothing to do with not offering any complications on the free plan. I can get the weather for free(ad supported) on my phone,, but not my wrist? It’s ridiculous, that’s why I uninstalled. You don’t deserve any ad revenue from me.

title: Money grabbers
body: Emailed developer to inform him that his app was not working properly with the new Apple iOS/initiated changes for Home Screen widgets. Never emailed me back after I sent him a video showing what it was doing. But he sure immediately seized the opportunity to only include the new Home Screen widgets with his silver and gold pay subscriptions only (of course I have the bronze plan). So not only does he not get an upgrade to my current subscription I have had for years, he gets nothing going forward. Forecast bar deleted. Happy ex-customer.

title: Need a subscription for widgets!
body: Overall the app works great. Upgraded to a paid tier (bronze). Last update took the widget away need silver or gold for the widget to work. Unacceptable! Canceled subscription.

title: Weather widget doesn’t update
body: I loaded up the new iOS 14 widget, using the one that displays weather in multiple cities. It’s pretty useless - the weather doesn’t update, even after you tap the widget and go to the app.

title: Nothing works
body: I was never able to get Mac to sync. Got Apple Watch complication to work but nothing else. Now it won’t work after updates. Never even bothered to try Apple TV. Got the gold subscription. At this point nothing works and most links are dead or support is for previous versions. I have no idea what I have or have not subscription wise. Writing the review made me realize that it is time to delete everything and move on.

title: Extremely Disappointed
body: Discovered Forecast Bar early this morning. I was excited about some specific complications for my new Apple Watch Series 5 and all the other things offered by a seemingly well designed and popular app. After a couple of hours I was impressed enough to go ahead and purchase the Premium Subscription; mainly, so I could use the awesome watch features of Forecast Bar. Well, here I am about 12 hours later, and I have discovered that the app is stupid slow on both my watch and my phone. The phone app and the iPad app freeze on a regular basis causing me to quit and restart. The watch app doesn’t show data in the watch complications on a regular basis. I’ve read the FAQ item about this problem and followed all of the developer’s guidelines for remedy. As is, I have to manually refresh the watch app quite often so the watch complications will show data. When you look at a watch face, you want information at that instant – not after having to mess with some software. Also, the iPad version of Forecast Bar keeps alerting me that it is not connected to a watch – so, I can’t change some settings which means I don’t have full use of the iPad app. I know an iPad doesn’t work with an Apple Watch like an iPhone does, but having a less than fully functioning app is very disappointing. I hope this app can be fixed very soon. Otherwise, I will just have to delete Forecast Bar and move on to something else. Nobody has time for tech like this.

title: Rarely accurate
body: I have been using this app for a year, it’s a rare day when I can rely on the forecast

title: Watch app still does not work properly.
body: Paid subscriber. The watch face complication often shows the weather from hours or days ago which can get confusing. This can be sometimes remedied by opening the watch app but even that often only shows a loading icon. Opening the iOS app usually helps the watch app catch up but that defeats the purpose of the watch app. I sent this info to the developer weeks ago to which they told me the latest update takes care of this issue, though I had already installed that update. I followed their suggestions of changing the data source, deleting the app, restarting my devices, etc, which I did at least twice. The watch app is still not functioning on its own.

title: Has Promise
body: Since the WU app was destroyed by TWC (plus the subscription went to $20 a year!) I’ve been looking for something else. So far pretty good, but whenever I add a PWS, the app crashes. Any suggestions? (only gave you one star to illicit a response) Thanks

title: Cool, but doesn’t work
body: In the weeks since I’ve been using forecast bar for the watch complications, I’ve had multiple issues of the weather not updating. Most recently I haven’t been able to get it to stop showing 0°, with a high of 0° and a low of 0°. Seems like a problem for a weather app that I’m paying for.

title: Turns into a pumpkin!
body: App work great during trail period but has been a joke since I paid to keep it. Run away.

title: Stops completely if you don’t pay
body: I expected that my specific “pro” features would go away when my subscription ran out. But instead, the whole app stopped working. Lame.

title: Beware Subscription
body: Developer is very defensive about misleading consumers to think that this is a free app. If the developer chooses very high end and services and the costs are too expensive in order to offer the app for free s/he should be upfront about it and charge money for the app. Offering it for free and then charging a subscription fee is like a bait and switch operation.

title: Subscriptions are for folks with disposable income l
body: Not everyone can afford subscriptions. Please provide option for lifetime purchase.

title: Great functionality, but...
body: The interface and functionality are wonderfully detailed, both on the phone and my watch. I love the customization and widget functionality. The weather is very accurate and I love the alert customization. My only gripes, which sadly, are deal breakers for me are 1) The radar is very slow to load compared to other apps such as My Radar and The Weather Channel. And 2) I can't use this app on my apple watch (series 3) without having to connect to my phone's Bluetooth! Every other weather app I've used allows me to use them without my phone needing to be present, why doesn't this one! If you make this app standalone usable with the apple watch, I will give it five stars and make it my go-to weather app.

title: Don’t waste your money
body: I get weather alert notifications and when I go to read the notification it only reads (null). Been some wild weather the last few days and Forecast Bar sent a lot of alerts and all just said (null). My other weather apps all included the alert text. I have the Premium subscriptions for iPhone, Mac and Apple Watch too. Support emails I’ve sent in the Forecast Bar app on iPhone has never been responded. Not a good sign. So, I’ve deleted the app on iPhone, Mac and Apple TV and canceled the subscriptions, yeah with a year to go on all. Bye non-responding support. Sorry I wasted my money.

title: I second the “Bait and Switch” comment
body: I couldn’t agree more with the person who said this app is a classic “bait and switch.” I saw NOTHING about this being a ‘trial offer’ or that certain features would be unavailable in a short time. Within a few days or so, it showed that the RADAR was no longer available, but I could upgrade to the premium version. I found this very strange and quite unbelievable. Then, shortly after this, it said the app was not available unless I upgraded. There MAY be other apps like this around, but I’ve NEVER seen one quite this disgusting and deceitful. They want to wet your appetite and then pull the plug so they can get more money. This stinks and I feel it is an underhanded tactic. I don’t care what the so-called developers claim, this is a bait and switch and would NEVER buy the premium version from a company that operates in this manner. I would never recommend it, either. Just the opposite in fact. Frankly, I don’t see anything special about the weather app. I have about a dozen weather apps and there is nothing laudable about this app. It seems very ordinary in terms of other weather apps and as I said I would NEVER recommend it. Shoddy tactics as I, and another reviewer, see it ! I see the so-called “Developer” has now added a response. I had checked my review a number of times over a period of time and saw no response. It looks like my review is now on the front page of the App listing which may have prompted them to finally respond. I find their response completely disingenuous and insulting. It looks like the same response they repeatedly post. We’re I the only one or one of only a FEW who have made the same complaint, their pat response might have more believability. As it stands, MANY people have made the same complaint which should be a clue to them. Frankly, I’m surprised that the App Store allows this sort of tactic. It’s not just the overall rating that should be important, but the sheer number of people who have had the same complaint and that is a LOT. It is a bait and switch tactic and it’s not above board. Suffice to say, I didn’t pay for the premium version as I find their approach to be highly questionable.

title: Watch app not working
body: I paid subscription fee for phone and watch and app on my watch is not working what gives? Can I get the app working please. Thanks

title: Can't install on Apple watch???
body: Looks like a nice app but it won't install on my apple watch.

title: Disappointed, buyer beware, questionable customer support
body: Downloaded app with 7 day free trial. Apple Watch app not working on my series 4 watch. Contacted support and they responded saying that the watch only works with the paid version and asked if I was still on my free trial. I responded right away, but haven’t received a response. Emailed two more times, still waiting for a response or a resolution, been at least 3 days now. Going to let the free trial expire and will not purchase. Be aware before you spend anything, you may be as disappointed as me.

title: Total ripoff
body: Looked great at first but then, one by one, what was free all of a sudden must be paid for. It’s called bait and switch and it’s wrong. No thanks!

Will be deleting this app. Good weather info but folks don’t like being nickled and dimed, and don’t like being positioned to pay in a suspect way, i.e., the con job!

title: Dishonest about 7 day trial...
body: Didn’t realize limited time to try out app before being charged but willing to test before committing to purchase. Says free for 7 days but today on day 3, getting message that app is overloaded so free trials don’t have access but try again later. How about try again never!!!

title: Worthless for actual weather.
body: The app looks very good and there are tons of customization options. Unfortunately, the weather conditions and forecast are almost always completely wrong. Once there was a snow storm outside and the app was reporting sunny weather. The temperature is usually off by 2-5C. When comparing the information with other 4 or 5 apps, this one is the one that seems to be wrong. I contacted the developer and they told me that a choice of different weather providers would be available, but so far no luck. So, pretty but useless.

title: Misleading
body: I would have given this app a 5, it was perfect, giving me everything I wanted including estimate of humidity levels in future forecasts. But surprisingly after about 5 days I get notified that my trial period has expired and I have to pay to continue receiving what I consider basic news. Deleting app right after my review is posted!

title: Not accurate weather

Yesterday it called for heavy rain all morning but it was clear skies all day. Same again this morning. It would be nice if this was fixed. after a couple of months it appears it will not. I am now searching for a new app

title: Bait and Switch

title: You want money??

title: Radar often not available in free trial
body: I’m done with data being overlaid on top of the radar that I can’t turn off. I don’t even know what the data is and the developers don’t care enough to answer my question. I won’t pay for an app the developers apparently can’t control. My search for a good weather app continues. I'm enjoying my trial of the app, except radar is frequently under "extremely heavy load" and only available to subscribers. I haven't been able to see the radar for the last 5 days. It is basically a Dark Sky clone. That's where their data comes from.

title: Bait and switch
body: When I downloaded this app because of the iMessage features, it wasn't clear at all that this was for a trial period, then if I want to keep the functionality, I have to pay. It's a bait and switch and I'm super turned off. It doesn't matter how much I liked the app in iMessage, on my phone, my Apple Watch, whatever, I'm not going to pay to play. It's a shame too, as the app gave me most of what I was looking for, but I'm not interested in having to pay every year to unlock functionality on my phone, then extra for functionality on my watch. Had this app been a pay once and up front for everything sort of app, I'd have very strongly considered it, as it's what I'm looking for, but like I said, the bait and switch nature of their sales pitch has completely turned me off. I get a week of functionality for free? Ridiculous. It's on me for not being aware of this from the get go? Yeah, but honestly, when you're downloading sometjing for use in iMessage, are you usually taking the time to read all of the details? No! Deleting and going back to the other paid apps I use that don't bait and switch like this junk.

No biggie for me, as I already own every weather APP already. This one was my favorite. More so because it and the desktop version costed so my wife. Let's see what happens.

title: The joke is on me...
body: Leaving aside the fact I feel duped after the seven day 'free' trial, this app is a joke. It takes forever to load, crashes at start up too many times to count, and is plain inaccurate. Yes the breadth of detail is nice, but as has been said, there is nothing here that you can't find elsewhere for free. I have a calendar date for the expiry of my use of this app. I shall be declining to support when that day arrives.

title: Hidden In-App Purchases and Not Linked to the tvOS App
body: This app cost me money up front when I purchased the tvOS version of the app, but is apparently free up front with later in-app purchases with the iOS version of the app. Why didn't the developer link the iOS app to the tvOS app and handle them both the same way? $$$ perhaps? When I purchase something, as I did with the tvOS version of this app, I expect the transaction to be complete and the product to work properly on all supported platforms (including iOS) once the transaction is complete. I am not interested in hidden purchases later. Just link all platforms as the same app, charge the necessary cost up front, and be done with it. Don't bother me later for more money. Otherwise, I really like this app, and would have liked to give it 5 stars.

title: Trial version
body: This app is a trial version, and need to pay for every year.

title: Total Ripoff! Greedy Developer!

Then they locked it & demanded an annual subscription to unlock it. I don't think so!!! It might be worth a one time fee, but definitely not a subscription! The developer is just being greedy.

title: Developers charging for background updates
body: This developer charges for background updates - a core function for a weather app - across all the devices they support. So not only do you pay for the app itself, you'll pay annually for simple background updating. It is a despicable cash grab. There are PLENTY of free or less expensive options out there. I'm deleting my apps and requesting refunds.

title: Not Worth It
body: I pay for apps, and not just 99¢. This app, while pretty, was not useful enough (for free) for me to open more than 3-4 times in the 3 weeks I had it. Whatever, it was free and I was too lazy to delete it. Update, holds the app ransom for $3-$5. There was zero warning beforehand. Do the update and you must pay to play. Seeing no value, I'm not playing. Your mileage may very. I will continue using Dark Sky--efficient, useful, paid for it gladly.

body: I downloaded Forecast Bar based on Apps Gone Free's recommendation. I would have kept it but after a one week "trial" it wanted me to pay for access for one year. This is not my concept of a "free app." Deleted.

title: Craptastic
body: Really fun part was that it was said to be free and promoted as such but in reality it was a free trial, misleading and lying, not smart. Also gps didn't work right, worthless app.

title: Seriously a Subscription Price?
body: The information they offer is great and if this had been a one time purchase I would have gotten the app and given it five stars but paying a subscription for what a lot of other apps give you at no charge or a one time charge just isn't worth it...

title: Suddenly stopped working
body: Watch displays a big water drop icon instead of the weather. Useless. Apple's built in Weather app is much more reliable and useful

title: Hidden charges
body: Wold be good if not for hidden subscription chargesuNdelete for good.

title: Bait and switch!!! NO THANKS!!!
body: Usually subscription apps don't cost anything to download... This is one of the greediest developers I've seen...

title: Bait & Switch
body: I downloaded this from Appsgonefree. Then looked in the settings and found that it's only free for a few days, and then we have to pay a subscription fee. False advertising! I wasted my time downloading the app, because now I have to delete it.

title: Scam
body: Dev says it's free, but it is subscription-based

title: Scram
body: Greedy app! Requires subscription

title: Meh.
body: Like a drug dealer, first ones free. It looks good. Does what I want... but subscription fee? C'mon guys. There's a million weather apps out there that deliver the same information free. Yours doesn't look THAT good. Weather now does the same, also free. AccuWeather also provides wonderfully accurate information. I'm deleting this app now.

title: Not accurate in rural areas
body: Not accurate in the San Bernardino Mountains east of Los Angeles. Seems to be getting weather information from the flatlands of LA instead of what we have here at 6750 feet in Big Bear. Don't bet your life on it in the winter time.

title: 7 day trail
body: This isn't a full fledged app so much as it's a seven day trail that you then have to pay a subscription to continue using.

title: 7-day trial? 👎🏽
body: No thanks.

title: Garbage
body: I do not deny the nice look and unique customization ability but I wonder why an app of $3.99 needs in app purchases! Unless the developers are the forecasting company which I doubt so I classify this app among the trash.

title: Subscription now
body: You have to pay an ongoing subscription fee to get updates in the background. Otherwise, this won't notify you of storms and freezing. This is just a bloated short term forecast then that you can get from any other app or site for free if you don't subscribe.

title: Quicker to just wait for the 10:00 news
body: App won't ever open. Just thinks and thinks trying to locate me but never does. It's quicker just to wait for the local 10:00 News Report. I want my money back.

title: Terrible
body: Don't work well on Apple watch. I want a refund!!

title: Save your money and get Dark Sky
body: Watch complications rarely function (after in app purchase). This uses Dark Sky/Forecast.io data. Go with the original and save five bucks.

title: Really
body: Apple Watch app doesn't work. Just says to open on phone.

title: Charging you for Apple Watch complications to work?
body: What a rip off, just to get the complications to work you have to pay $8 for a weather app.

title: Radar
body: The radar is a joke. Has to do a 30-40 frame count before loading. Good app otherwise. If looking to buy a weather app I’d probably pass on this one just because of the Radar.

title: Latest rewrite ugh
body: Updated review: They have improved (restored) the appearance now, provided you have time to tweak all the settings, but the need to go through all that again after an update is a pain. That's why I'll let the review below stand. (I'm also no longer receiving any pollen data. Change in their data source? I don't (or no longer) see a setting for that, so who knows..) PREVIOUS: Maybe I'll grow to like the rewrite, but right now I can say that having to redo all my settings and get used to the new, far less polished look wasn't much fun. Color me irritated. Things are too busy now and thus less useful. All the backgrounds are busy too. Accessibility and usability have taken big hits. Have unsubscribed after years of regular usage.

title: Unwanted notification
body: I keep getting earthquake notifications even though I have them turned off. So annoying!

title: Widgets no longer work.
body: I’ve have been using this app on all of my Apple devices for over two years with no problems. Earlier last week I noticed that the widget no longer displays any info unless you open it. I reached out by email with no response. I will most likely be canceling my service if I don’t receive anything shortly.

title: Disappointing app with misleading claims
body: App is buggy and developer did not respond to my request for assistance. When I try to use gradient backgrounds there is a hard black line the scrolls around. Their website claims you can change weather sources, but there is no option for that. Also the widgets are bugging with the home screen one breaking and requiring re-installing the app to fix and the lock screen widget displays in Celsius despite the app being set to F. I messed up by not dumping it during the trial subscription.

title: Forever to Update Location & No Response from Support
body: When getting off a flight, this app takes forever to update location. I don’t understand it. It has full access to precise location services. This is after force quitting and reopening the app. It take about an HOUR. The widget is even worse. Once the app finally updates, the widget still shows the old location, probably for ANOTHER HOUR. Even worse, despite numerous emails to support with screenshots, I’ve yet to receive a response. The only reason this is 2 stars not 1 is that their rain data is highly accurate in Mexico, whereas Apple’s app is a literal joke.

title: Long time user until…
body: I was a long time user of the app until the accuracy declined. This used to be the most accurate app up until recently. Then for whatever reason, the app would say we were to have no precipitation but we were having 6 inches of snow dumped on us. We were also having a blizzard, and the app would say nothing about that, but just that we had a slight chance of precipitation. We couldn’t drive on the roads and businesses closed down for the day. Things like that. I’ve now moved on to another app that’s been much more accurate.

title: Nice app but inconsistent widget and no option to contact support.
body: Widget doesn’t work consistently on my phone. But I notice that app support and contact links don’t function. “Requested url not found” Starting to regret my purchase. Also, customizable Apple Watch faces don’t download.

title: New Version
body: Not a fan of the new look - definitely needs improvement especially on iPhone display: bubbles are too big, info is off screen, bubbles are overlapping for example settings overlap locations on display. Annoying pop ups every time I start the app with no way to turn those off (I’m Gold subscribe). The older version looked better.

title: Boots at a snail’s pace
body: The new and improved latest versions is the slowest launching app that I have ever seen. It is a no go for me. Sorry.

title: It was good
body: The APP was good before the last update. Since the last update the watch complications do not work. You can not even open the app on the watch at all. Also the widget on the phone does not update to current location unless you open it and force refresh yourself. Prior to this latest update as of 02/19/23 I would have given it 5 stars after this update and as of today 02/20/23 I have to give it 2 stars for the lack or workability and extreme loss of features. DO NOT BUY UNTILL THEY FIX THIS ISSUE.

title: Trial version then zero information
body: I like the app and the watch complications. After a week it blocked ALL information and functionality. Not clear at all that this is a trial only. The message Trial ended and subscription Ad is all I see now. Why not a model with some basic services with an upgrade option. Now I feel like they scammed me and in not sure I want to send them my money. Similar reviews from others now that I look. Only option now is to delete this app and move on to one of the other 50 or so weather apps.

title: Bugs in update
body: This was my favorite weather app but since update the data in the widget does not populate. It is greyed out and not visible. I’ve uninstalled and re-installed. It shows then is gone again the next morning. Wonder if it’s having conflicts with focus mode. Please fix

title: Has potential, but watch app is useless
body: Phone app works well and as advertised, but the watch app, for which I got the app for, is garbage. Not only are the daily forecasts completely wrong, the watch complication doesn’t load after forcing a sync refresh.

title: Widget Layout Bad
body: Widget layouts need overhaul. Text and objects crowd or overlap the edges. Poor design. Besides super annoying, renders them unusable. Particularly frustrating since I have a paid subscription.

title: Works but so do free apps
body: App works as intended and has a nice complication for the Apple Watch. That said, there are plenty of other places to get weather information for free, so paying for a subscription just isn’t worth it.

title: Great when it works, Apple Watch sync issues
body: It’s a great app with tons of customization options, but the load/ lag between the watch and phone can be hurrendous. You may either have to load the phone app to get the watch to update, or it may crash when trying to use the watch app as well

title: Apple Watch
body: Apple Watch complication glitchy, unresponsive, and unreliable.

title: Has Potential / Falls Short
body: The iOS version has potential but the GUI layout is a little awkward compared to both the other available options and the macOS and tvOS versions. It’s also buggy. The app was reluctant to change locations, agonizingly slow when it did, and often required restarts on both my iPhone and iPad. And the subscription levels are very expensive, especially because you need a separate subscription for your desktop and iOS versions. Strangely, however, the tvOS version is a one time purchase at $3.99. While its GUI is also a little awkward and occasionally inconsistent, it is at least reasonably priced. If they fix the bugs which cause lag and give it a reasonable pricing structure (one time fee preferred), I’d definitely use it. Until then, it’s not worth the significant cost.

title: Fix Widgets
body: Per last update “Dramatically improved home screen widgets performance” that’s a joke right? My widget in no way is in sync with the app. Needs work & fast! I’m NOT happy paying for the silver subscription and this shoddy app performance!

title: Not worth it
body: Most downloaded weather app. Soon to be most deleted. Don’t be greedy guys..

title: Apple Watch
body: I’m considering subscribing but my Apple Watch is ALWAYS out of sync. I’m thinking maybe I need to have a paid subscription for that to work properly, but 1) that would be kind of ridiculous and 2) I don’t think it will help. Why doesn’t the watch app stay in sync?

title: Phone app is good but watch app is rubbish
body: For one the watch app doesn’t update, two the complication doesn’t update. And the developer doesn’t respond to requests for help. Can’t fathom why anyone would pay.

title: Repeat notifications
body: I typically love this app for weather alerts and radar but this evening I keep getting the EXACT SAME notification every 2 minutes for a weather alert (wind advisory) that is already expired.

title: Decent
body: While this is a decent free weather app, it heavily relies on my iPhone to work, if I’m out of range of my iPhone which I tend to be a lot it doesn’t work on its own through my watch it seems to need to have the app reopened on the phone to load any data. If this is fixed I’ll redownload, for now I’ve switched.

title: Disapointing
body: Loved the idea of having temp info on my Apple Watch face. However, after moving from my home location, the watch display noted my new location name, but displayed weather info from my old location. I mailed their support about the issue and got no feedback. Stay away.

title: Not as good as it used to be
body: It’s ok, used to be better. Huge difference in weather between dark sky and the weather company. And on dark sky the weather alerts don’t give any information. Reads (null). As an update; I’ve emailed support twice with no response. Time to move on I think.

title: Update
body: I like the app but when I go to check the weather on my watch it won’t load I have to open the app on my phone then open it on my watch for it to refresh which defeats the purpose I really like the app but gonna have to find a different one due to this.

title: Basics: great. Extras: poor.
body: The app does what it’s supposed to do on the iPhone and iPad. In fact it does so a skosh better than most other apps of its kind. A clean and customizable interface along with little “above and beyond” items (like the temperature on the app icon) make it a pleasure to use in the phone. It’s a bit annoying that the icon looks like its for a water intake tracking app (see: just about every water intake tracking app in the store; their stickers icon would be better) but that’s minor. Tha Apple Watch is a different story. I’m a paid (annual) Full Access + Watch subscriber but the watch app doesn’t even show up. I’ve written to the dev multiple times and received no response at all. Not even an acknowledgement of receipt. An app that doesn’t give what you paid for, and a dev that won’t even respond to requests for support doesn’t merit a good rating, even when the basics of the app are fine.

title: Great looking app...but
body: IOS version is strange when compared to other weather apps. It's not really a stand alone app. Temp badge will not show current temp without macbook sync enabled. Other weather conditions do not update automatically, while at the same time the MacBook version works great when not synced!

title: Does not update
body: Does not update on Apple Watch properly

title: Something's Changed
body: i've been using Forecast Bar for over two years now and in that time i'd rate my satisfaction anywhere between 90-99%. recent updates, however, have forced me to start reconsidering whether i keep the app as my main source of weather updates and predictions. the information is just as great as it's always been, but these last few updates have made the app unstable and sometimes nearly unusable. immediate freezing, blank screens when in the app, forcing my entire phone to lock up, and generally just *not good*. i don't know if Forecast Bar is trying to do too much with the family of apps across the Watch, iPhone, and desktop, but the more functionality they stick in, the worse it seems to get. and yes, i'm a fully paid subscriber on all platforms.

title: Used to be great
body: This app used to be the best, but this release is extremely buggy almost to the point of being unusable. Please patch quickly!!

title: Great app but pricing is crazy
body: I love this weather app. It's extremely customizable and displays weather information very clearly. I would be happy to pay for it, but as a one time charge. I don't like how the developer wants to charge an annual subscription.

title: App wants subscription for repackage
body: The app does a decent job of displaying the information in an easy to read and use format. However, the glaring issue is it merely pulls its info from the Dark Sky developer but then wants an ongoing annual subscription. Personally, I would much rather purchase Dark Sky for a fair onetime fee than pay this developer an ongoing subscription to display another app's info. If this developer would have charged a single fee rather than a subscription, it would have done much better. Eventually the updates will stop and the few people who did pay for this app will be left with a dead app.

title: Nice app but...
body: This is a decent app, push notifications work well and the layout is nice but yearly subscription service...really? I'd gladly pay a one time fee but the subscription service needs to be rethought. Might as well just purchase Dark Sky.

title: Bait and switch
body: Should be more upfront about it being a limited time free trial. If it surprised anybody, it is a bad experience.

title: Bait & Switch irritates
body: This is a decent weather app on macOS and when I saw the iOS go from $4 to free I thought it was worth checking out. I was not pleased to find that a few days later it stopped working and wanted a $3/yr subscription. Well, that might be reasonable, but they could have warned me that this would happen instead of pretending it was free. That gives a bad taste it is hard to get rid of. Whoever decided to hide the change shouldn't be deciding these things. Frankly, the main weather screen is nice, but the thousands of customizations are annoying. Pick some nice settings for me and leave me alone. I have not yet decided if I will subscribe or not, probably not as it seems a bit steep for a marginally above average experience. For $3-4 this is a decent one-payment app, but an annual subscription at that level is too high for what I've seen. I might come back to it later, but for now it isn't that appealing.

title: Has Potential, Business Model Needs Rethinking
body: I wanted to love this app, I really did. I gave it a chance testing it for a few weeks. The UI is gorgeous and I think part of the allure in weather app’s is how the info is presented. This app nails that. That being said… This is a terrible model for pay to play. I was unaware just how locked down this app was until the free trial ran out and you needed to unlock the app just to get access. On top of that just to get access to sections such as radar and watch requires another purchase. I’m reasonable and understand the need for paid apps. I think the devs could do a better job explaining what is included up front and what you get when you sign up for a subscription. I wanted this app to replace Dark Sky. It falls short in that it needs a host device such as a Mac or a Watch to forward push notifications. Considering the amount of money you pay for a yearly subscription this seems like something that can be implemented and explained much better. I think this app has potential but the devs need to rethink the business model.

title: Subscription bummer
body: I had a week free trial and really liked the design and layout. It was my favorite weather app for my watch as well, since it showed the current temperature in big numbers. When my free trial ran out, I was all set to pay for it. Then I saw that it was an annual subscription fee. Really? No thanks. If this was a one time purchase, it's a no brainer...I'd buy it.

title: Nice looking App
body: Nice looking and functional app. But, then, there are the two available yearly subscriptions. Upon seeing this the app was deleted. Can't say about others but this one is getting tired of these types of subscription models. Otherwise, this app looks and feels great.

title: Where's the data?
body: Nice app - if you live near a weather station. I live in the mountains of North Carolina, and right now Forecast Bar indicates that it's 41 degrees out - my thermometer says 22, and my birdbath is frozen solid. It turns out that the data is coming from Morganton, which is 57 miles away and NOT in the mountains. I'll go back to using WeatherBug - which uses a network of local weather reporting stations such as schools and small airports.

title: But...
body: Nice app, except the part where you charge another 4 bucks just so it will refresh in the background!! And that's PER year! Misleading for sure. Why? Because the watch app is useless without the app updating in the background! So 8 bucks the first year, and 4 every year after that...

title: Worse and more costly now
body: This used to be a fine app that I paid for happily. In the past several months, weather map feature has lost its simplicity and speed. I’m going to try a different weather app.

title: Nice but buggy.
body: I like it but app is buggy. Astronomy notification does not stay on and widgets are buggy. Also live activities will say it’s raining when snowing. Needs work.

title: Weather is good but watch face doesn't work
body: The watch face doesn't work either but I like the layout

title: Ok but watch faces don’t workout
body: I love the desktop app for Mac. And this app on iPhone is ok. But the appearance on the iPhone is vastly different than desktop. The desktop app is sleek and well ordered. The iPhone app is less appealing. The watch faces don’t download. Disappointing

title: Widgets are broken on iOS 16
body: Since the latest October upgrade, optimized for iOS 17, the widgets don’t work—I’m using iOS 16.7.2, iPhone 8. All I see is square boxes only with no info at all. Gold subscriber, love the app, want my widgets back.

title: Update
body: Update: appearance customizations are slowly coming back but what about the Time Machine feature? The newest update removed all visual customization that convinced me to pay for this app in the first place. Now the app is ugly to look at and I wasted $30.

title: Unreliable
body: App doesn’t function reliably. Widgets in particular refuse to update either location or accurate weather. It displays weather data from location days ago, rather than current location.

title: Good but buggy
body: Developer needs to take some time to get the bags out.

title: no pressure complication displayed on series 8
body: when selected, the pressure complication does not display at all, or displays the generic static icon before blanking. all other complications seem to display as expected. silver subscriber.

title: Works fine
body: Works fine… but you need to buy the two most expensive subscriptions if you want it to work on your watch.

title: Good overall app
body: Good overall weather app and customizable with proper subscription tier. Weather alerts notifications speed can use some work. They are definitely slower than other apps. I bought subscription for MAC OS platform which indicated cross device subscription. Worked for a while on iPhone and iPad but now when I open app it brings me to subscription screen. Hmmmm!

title: Watch app is unreliable; phone app and widgets are great
body: If the watch complications were as attractive and reliable as the phone widgets I’d give this five stars, but they’re not. They don’t update reliably, frequently only showing the blank dashes. The graph complication never had worked accurately but doesn’t show an error, just shows the default image.

title: Forecast Bar
body: Very useful with a lot of information, has everything you need to be informed, not all of it is always accurate though. Seems like they are updating it regularly to fix the glitches though.

title: Radar crashes when zooming
body: The radar is beautiful but whenever I zoom or pan the radar while it is in animation, the app crashes. A workaround is to use a custom radar URL, but this bug is highly annoying. (I am subscribed to the app at the highest level.)

title: Watch Complication Has Become Too Complicated
body: Since the latest update I can't get Watch complication to work. Stays blank. Edit: Now home face complication shows five day forecast, but the forecast is not for my location, but when I tap it shows forecast for my location. Weird. Like I said, too complicated. Wasted my money.

title: Please bring the radar back to the watch app
body: App is great. I left it after the radar was removed from the watch app and turned to Carrot Weather. I keep coming back hoping to see it restored and it never is. Just wish I didn’t have to subscribe just to find out that basic function is still missing.

title: Forecast good; software meh
body: The forecasting generally is quite good, with a very good, customizable UI; and, for a fee the same app runs on the Mac. But, (1) the radar runs fine on the Mac but never ever runs well, if at all, on the iPhone (12 running 14.5.1) or the iPad (Air 3 running 14.5.1); and, (2) the watch app is attractive but useless because its refresh process is glacially slow, thus the watch face temperature is never accurate. Often you have to open the app, hard press to refresh, then wait . . . wait . . . é voila, current data.

title: Good app but bad widget
body: I love the app but the widget refused to load properly at first. The widget loads with no graphics. It will launch and open properly. I’ve tried multiple times to edit the widgets, deleting the old and installing the new and it still won’t load properly. After several more attempts to load the new widget, it now won’t load at all. I have cycled power on my iPad to see if it would reload, to no avail. If widgets are important for you then, you’ll have to use another weather app. This current version widget simply doesn’t work.

title: Still the best, still only average
body: Still far too buggy, slow and way too expensive. Now missing temperature badge. Sigh. Why are all weather apps so bad?

title: Watch features need work
body: I really like the idea of this app. The app is really nice, it looks good, gives me information just the way I would want, and had plenty of customization but the main reason I got the app was for its watch features and well they don’t really work for me. I set everything up as I wanted in the app, set the complication on my watch and closed off the app, the complication showed just what it was suppose to but that’s where it stopped. From there on the only way to get the complication to show accurate info is to open the app, refresh it and then swipe it closed. I’ve tried opening the app on the watch and waiting a bit but it doesn’t work, has to be the app on the phone. I guess I will keep looking for a good weather app that’s friendly w my watch cause no one wants to have to open an app on their phone every 30 minutes or hour to see what the correct weather is.

title: Not sure what’s going on
body: Either the developers mess with the app too much or they just can’t get it right. I paid for the app because it now totally does not work without paying. But even then, the watch only updates the weather when I open the app on the phone. Making it pointless and no better then any other weather app. Sometimes it works sometimes it doesn’t. Sometimes it works after an update and then after another update it doesn’t. Right now it doesn’t.

title: Would be great if...
body: ...it reliably loaded. Widget, app, Watch app... All don't load after a while and have trouble with geolocation. I thought it might be problems with the Verizon network but it will do it on Wi-Fi too. If they can fix that, the app will be perfect. When it works, it's fantastic.

title: Nice app but notifications don’t work
body: I like the app a lot. Lots of flexibility in designing how you want each element to look. My one complaint is with alert notifications. I never get any. It’s currently raining as I write this and I didn’t get a notification. I’ve set it up to give me a daily summary at 7am and it never arrives. I have the paid premium subscription and have notifications for the app turned on

title: Double dipping
body: It’s a decent enough app. Hate when they charge extra to get it on Mac, then also on Apple TV so they lose a star for that.

title: Missing
body: Still don’t have radar on iwatch. Disappointed

title: Mediocre at best
body: Wanted to get a 3 day trial since I tested the app in 10-2016. They didn’t have an option for that and said to wait for a monthly subscription. Bought it anyway and the radar is pretty crappy. The implementation is poor and the “you are here” indicator doesn’t always show up. Also, the overlays don’t work well, either and reappear and disappear randomly. Ick. In addition, they answered questions for me until I bought the app. Then they stopped communicating with me after they got my money. Apple Watch app doesn’t work well but it’s the prettiest when it actually does work. Updating it is slow and it just doesn’t do it reliably whatsoever, even when you request for the update. Overall if I had to do it again I would not buy it. Not updating a weather app in 6 months with all the bugs I found should have been my warning sign. Buy it at your own risk and deal with the bugs :(

title: Didn’t know this was subscription based
body: Am I to understand that a standard subscription is 2.99 per year, not per month?

title: Good app BUT
body: This is a good app but subscription cost is to high and I must subscribe for all my devices phone tv and MacBooks. Just way to much money and half the time the radar doesn't work and when it does it's rudimentary at best. Like what is good but I don't think I will renew my subscription.

title: It's only ok
body: I find that my other app gets it right more often. It's ok, but not enough to pay a subscription again.

title: Great app but doesn't sync
body: I love this app. Have it on my Mac and iPhone and iPad. Even paid extra on Mac for more frequent updates. BUT...the 3 apps won't sync like they're supposed to.

title: Good app but could be GREAT....
body: If the size of the text was configurable. Text is so tiny in the widget it hurts my eyes. Please, please size the text for us old timers. Otherwise I just can't renew my annual subscription when my current one expires. Sorry.

title: Good program
body: Nice program and it works well. But it is really not free as they want you to pay a yearly subscription. Price on it is not bad but paying for others repackaged data does not seem right. Program has been deleted.

title: Got the app
body: When it was a deal of the day down from 3.99. But why does it say free trial expired

title: Not incredibly awesome
body: It will not fetch your data until you subscribe Which I think is pretty ridiculous and uncool why don't they just get rid of In app purchases it is just a big waste of time and money it also would even make sense to have the extra features for just a month I bet the money doesn't even go to the developer and goes to some random app if it is fixed by next update it will be better.

title: Does not tell you subscription-based
body: I downloaded the app because it looked great and was free today and with my profession I need to track weather. However in going through the settings the app told me I only had authorization through October. I should've been told it was a only a free app for a month.

title: Well...
body: The app works well. However, I can't justify spending $4 for the app, and an additional yearly fee of $4 for the complication functionality. AccuWeather, Apple's weather app, Yahoo and The Weather Channel, offer complications at no extra cost (FREE!).

title: Watch app not a ready for watchOS 3 player
body: The iPhone app works as well as ever under iOS 10. But the watch app works WORSE on my watch. Going on 5 minutes now -- make that 6 -- for it to load under WatchOS 3. If an update fixes this, I will gladly post a deserved 5 star rating. But the watch problem loses it 2 stars for now.

title: Has hard time communicating with Apple Watch
body: When it works it really cool. But I live in Houston TX., and my watch resets itself to the Cupertino, CA. - frequently!

title: Notification widget does work / radar takes long time
body: While I like the app and its interface, the widget doesn't work. Just says "loading weather". Also the radar takes longer than necessary to load. In addition is like to see the notifications be brought into the application instead of being sent to browser to view webpage.

title: Great but Watch Widget is Broken
body: I love this app. But the watch widget is always broken. We want the 5-day forecast to work always be working.

title: Abandoned?
body: I really love the design and customization options of this app, as well as its Mac version. However, their formerly super quick and helpful support seems to be defunct. I no longer get any reply. I am wondering if this app is abandoned – and is it ethical to keep charging a subscription for an app that is no longer supported or maintained? Disappointed.

title: Rain
body: Can you notify me when rain will start?

title: I've really liked this app until

Those icons made the app clean and easy to use. Also the length of the forecast summaries is very long now, it seems. Wish I could customize this app, again. That's what set it apart from many weather apps have all the same look to them. That made it stand out. Now it looks like the rest (with a great feature set).

title: Not showing current temp on watch. Stays at 69

title: Dates not shown and two other deficiencies

To be fair, it is accessible, but it’s by tapping on the left column, which would be fine. The problem is that when doing so other data is lost and one can’t view both fields of data together. They list the high temperature first, and then the low in the extended forecast. While there may be a few days, especially in the fall, when the temperature steadily declines throughout the day, typically the temperature is lowest around sunrise and highest in the late afternoon, the former of which comes first. Merely a minor annoyance for me, but may be more significant for those who are on an odd schedule up and more alert after midnight. From midnight for up to four hours, only eleven days, as opposed to fourteen, are shown on the extended forecast. Believe I have mentioned all of this, and possibly more that may be escaping me, to them in contact efforts, but have yet to see any change. Hope this is of some help. Thanks

However, now that dark mode is baked into iOS13, I find myself disappointed with the current implementation and my inability to get my in-app weather screen to embrace the loveliness that is Dark Mode. The app reflects Dark Mode within the settings screens of the app and on the widgets, but the in-app weather screen (where all your forecasts and such are) it does not (I’d love to be wrong and have missed some quirky detail here). I think this is where the customization backfires because I can only get my app to display in a mid-range grey colored background. Technically I could try to achieve a fully black background by creating my own background pack via the customization (and I have) but even this I cannot get to work and so I’m left without Dark Mode support in the one place in the app that I really, really want it. And so I think it’s a bit of a stretch to say that the app supports this new iOS feature when it isn’t done app-wide. Again, I’d love to be wrong here, but until I can get the app fully Dark, I’m not feeling it. Will update to 5* if/when the developers adjust their implementation to fully embrace Dark Mode app-wide.

title: Widgets now working (updated) - Great weather app for iOS 14
body: v7.1.2 on 9/25/20: The devs seem to have figured out the iOS widget framework in this latest update. All widget styles seem to be working perfectly now, and I’m even able to stack multiple Forecast Bar widgets with no issues. Great job making these improvements so quickly! Update 9/25/20: After updating my iPhone to iOS 14.0.1, Forecast Bar widgets are now working pretty well. Still a few issues to work out and some things that could make the app more user-friendly, but things are moving in the right direction. v7.1.1 on 9/24/20: Widgets still don’t work as well as I would expect. But with help from the developers via email, I was able to get a single widget of a certain style working just well enough to be usable. Some of the widget styles will not display data no matter what I do. They just remain blank. I tested the app on several different iPhones and an iPad and observed the same problems with widgets on every device, so it’s not an isolated issue. I have also tested 8-10 other weather apps with home widgets and they all work perfectly without any of the limitations that Forecast Bar seems to have at this point. The devs claim that iOS imposes an undocumented limit on how many calls third party widgets can make to be refreshed in a 24 hour period. So the recommendation was to only add a single Forecast Bar widget. I would like to use several different Forecast Bar widget styles in a stack to display various weather info, but for now, having a single widget seems to allow for better performance. Even with only one widget, unlike any other app widgets I’ve tried, it still takes 30+ seconds for the widget to populate with data initially or any time you edit the widget settings. And the widget data doesn’t seem to exactly match data in the full app, and widget refreshes happen less frequently than I would like. So I’m hoping for another update soon to address these issues and provide better stability, as well as fewer limitations. But the devs seem to be responsive and hard at work trying to improve the app after Apple surprised all iOS developers by releasing iOS 14 without warning. So I’ll try to be patient and wait for the app to catch up. If it does, I’ll increase my rating to reflect that. v7.1 on 9/22/20: The app has potential, but the widgets don’t work. Most of them are blank or behave erratically. It’s also very expensive app, which makes it extremely frustrating that it has such serious bugs. Please fix soon or issue refunds.

title: Tried SO many for so many years ...
body: I have bought so many iOS weather apps and many more that were free. They all were found lacking (e.g. lousy radar, clumsy user interfaces, no hourly forecasts, lack of flexibility, etc.). Forecast Bar has it all plus super customization! I had resisted Forecast Bar from the beginning; I am not a fan of subscriptions. But when I noticed that the iOS price was so reasonable (required over the free option so as to have radar) I decided I'd give it a try. I was immediately happy I did so. And then I noticed it applied to the iPad version as well. Best radar (so much better than Dark Sky's), best customization, easy as can be to refresh/update information, most information at a glance. Oh(!), the lock/home screen widget is likewise customizable and as information rich as you might want to set it up.

body: Just downloaded this app and haven't had time to fully appreciate it yet, but I like everything I've seen so far. Two requests: 1) Can you add a future aspect to the weather radar? I use that all the time on TWC app and it's extremely handy for making outdoor plans. If you had this capability I would only have to have your app on my phone and I would be grateful. 2) Hurricane Matthew is currently ravaging the coast of Florida and I would love to see what's going on there in realtime. I don't have a lot of time to "play" (meaning go online, Google "watch live streaming traffic web cameras in Fort Lauderdale," then try to find a real live streaming webcam so I can see what I want to see). I know there must be be other types of live cameras that show weather conditions and are accessible online, but I can rarely find them because I don't know the key words to Google. I suspect you are more savvy about that? In any case, it would be wonderful to be able to pick a city or state in your app and be presented with a list of live cameras to choose from to see the weather there. I (and probably many others) would be grateful for this capability and it would endear this app to me for life. In any case, great app! Well done!!

title: Exactly what I was looking for
body: This is the best weather app on the app store. And trust me, I've been looking for good ones for a while now. I used Yahoo Weather for a long time, but got tired of them not adding 3D touch and jumped ship to this one. It's the only app that has 3D touch quick actions, peek and pop within the app, a today widget that shows the daily highs and lows, and a clean minimalist interface with no ads. Wunderground came close, but this app's UI wins hands down. I understand the need to charge for background updates as well; API calls aren't cheap! Especially with forecast.io. If you've been looking for the perfect weather app, you've already found it. This one is exactly what I've been looking for since I first got an iPhone.
